articleTitle: Intelligent emotion recognition system using natural language processing and BERT
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Distributed Sensing and Intelligent Systems (ICDSIS 2021)
abstract: Emotions have always been one of the important aspects of our lives that influences everything. Being able to recognize emotions can help us in various domains such as psychology, human-computer interaction, e-learning, marketing and many more. A comparative study has been done on different approaches i.e., Traditional Machine Learning approach, Neural Network approach and Bidirectional Encoder Representations from Transformers (BERT) to evaluate which approach gives us the maximum accuracy, it has been evaluated on a dataset that was combined from dailydialog, isear, and emotion-stimulus datasets to create a balanced dataset with five labels: joy, sad, anger, fear, and neutral. We'll be concentrating on implicit emotion recognition, which is a challenging problem to tackle because emotion is hidden inside the text and solving it necessitates identifying the text's context. The resulting intelligent system will display emotions extracted from the text, which will be divided into five categories: joy, sadness, fear, rage, and neutral. The accuracy of the model was 91.72 percent, which is much higher than that of typical machine learning and neural network approaches.

articleTitle: Arabic handwritten recognition based on deep convolutional neural network
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Distributed Sensing and Intelligent Systems (ICDSIS 2021)
abstract: Automatic handwritten recognition is a simulation of the human reading process by converting a handwritten input to an editable typed form. A successful deployment of such a system requires a robust character handwritten recognition module. Research papers conducted on the Arabic language are scarce compared to other languages due to the complexity and cursive nature of the Arabic language where characters are written in a conjoined and owing manner. We propose two deep learning models based on a Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) to classify Arabic handwritten characters using two publicly available datasets AIA9K and AHCD. Pre-processing and data augmentation have been successfully utilized to improve performance. We employed an Arabic word segmentation algorithm to disassemble a word into its letters, which makes the input to the classification system. The experimental results demonstrate solid performance with an average accuracy of 96.72% and 98.21% on AIA9k and AHCD datasets, respectively. The performance is boosted to 97.54% and 98.82%, with data augmentation on the respective datasets. Furthermore, the two augmented datasets were merged to build a generalized model that achieved outstanding accuracy of 98.27% using a modified approach of LeNet-5.

articleTitle: In-vehicle flexray network security based on modified AES encryption algorithm
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Distributed Sensing and Intelligent Systems (ICDSIS 2021)
abstract: With the acceleration of automobile electronics and automation, and the constant maturity of technology, the safety and independence of the in-vehicle network system can no longer be guaranteed. Cars enhance the driving pleasure for the driver by connecting to smart phones, Bluetooth, the Internet, etc. Instead, it brings hacking, security loopholes , and other security issues that cannot be ignored, which seriously affects car driving safety, personal privacy, and even endangers public safety.This article is aimed at the safety of data transmission on the vehicle FlexRay bus, adopts the MixColumn method to improve the AES encryption algorithm comprehensively Compared with the traditional AES encryption algorithm, the modified AES encryption algorithm proposed in this paper increases the encryption speed and decryption speed by 26% and 30% respectively, which suits the real-time requirements of the actual vehicle bus network system. This further improves the security and real-time performance of vehicle Flexray bus information transmission.

articleTitle: Vision system of welding robot based on DA-XGboost algorithm
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Distributed Sensing and Intelligent Systems (ICDSIS 2021)
abstract: In recent years, machinery and artificial intelligence have been rapidly integrated into modern industrial production. Its development and use in our country's intelligent production lines have also received more and more attention and attention, and have been achieved in many modern industrial fields. Welding is currently one of the most widely used technologies in some projects. Traditional welding mainly uses manual teaching and copying. The work intensity is high and the working environment is not good, which cannot ensure the effect of the welding work. The increasing maturity of machine vision technology provides a more superior product quality, high efficiency, automation and intelligence development direction for traditional welding robots in our country. Therefore, research on welding industrial robots based on mechanical and vision technology is of great significance. This article discusses the welding robot vision system based on the da-xgboost algorithm, summarizes some key technical problems of the welding robot on the basis of some literature data, and then introduces the basic composition of the welding robot. Finally, the welding robot vision system is designed, and the designed welding robot vision system is tested to see if it meets the system requirements. The experimental results show that since the actual coordinates and the robot motion coordinates are obtained by manual measurement, there is a certain error. Even in this case, the absolute error of the entire vision system obtained is not more than 0.5mm, which meets the requirements of system application.

articleTitle: ROADR: towards road network assessment using everyone-as-a-sensor
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Distributed Sensing and Intelligent Systems (ICDSIS 2021)
abstract: Complete and up-to-date map data plays a critical role in many contemporary and future applications such as autonomous driving level 3+. In terms of crowdsourcing, a data basis can be created that meets these stringent requirements without dedicating additional resources. With ROADR, we present a holistic platform to gather knowledge about a road network and its properties to further enhance either semantic or syntactic information. The privacy-by-design platform uses a smartphone application to collect crowdsourced data and performs local machine learning. Only less sensitive data is forwarded to a centralized platform that aggregates and processes information from the crowd to provide value-added information found in a vehicle's trajectory. Also, the paper provides a thorough analysis of the respective Floating Phone Data indicating two exemplary events, namely traffic light and traffic circles. Our evaluation shows that the recognition is done in real-time but in a resource-efficient way.

articleTitle: V2V BER enhancement based on FFH-OFDM
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Distributed Sensing and Intelligent Systems (ICDSIS 2021)
abstract: This paper describes the performance enhancement for the V2V communications based on LTE systems. Due to the mobility factor among the communicating nodes, V2V systems have a major drawback from the bandwidth point of view. Thus, a study of the V2V systems based on BER performance enhancement has been investigated. This proposition is based on making use of both of fast frequency hopping orthogonal frequency division multiplexing and the multiple antennas to mitigate the Doppler spread effect on the V2V clustering benchmark, which contains both of a clustering weighting factor based stage and a multiparallel processing stage.The results show a noticeable stability compared to our previously published work by almost 25%, which also exceeds the achieved results from the Lower-ID DCA from both of the speed and communication range.

articleTitle: Evaluation of a blockchain-enabled multi-energy transaction system for district energy platforms
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Distributed Sensing and Intelligent Systems (ICDSIS 2021)
abstract: Nowadays, researchers are trying to improve and find new ways and methods to mitigate climate change and increase energy efficiency. Areas of study include smart grid, smart grid, distributed energy systems, accumulative and renewable energy sources. Renewable energy integration, system operation, transparent spending system and data integrity are the common challenges facing distribution network providers. The overall, holistic view of the technologies listed above about delivering and consuming any kind of energy has many aspects that need to be studied and optimized. Good compatibility with distribution systems is characterized by modern blockchain technology and multi-agent system. Blockchain has very good data protection, immutability and transparency properties in transactions. Its decentralized nature and automatic calculation system can bring great potential in terms of financing and calculation in the energy sector. In this thesis article a novel process to coordinate, allocate and settle energy transactions in a district multi-carrier energy system. The process operates in a decentralized way, fully on-chain. The design leaves producers the freedom to choose their preferred pricing strategy for profit maximization. The price-availability-based allocation system guarantees consumers the lowest possible cost.

articleTitle: Exploring novel adversarial attack strategies on android systems
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Distributed Sensing and Intelligent Systems (ICDSIS 2021)
abstract: As the proliferation and adoption of mobile phones becomes more and more common, so do the targets for malicious hackers, especially on the widely used android platform. Even the most secure anti-malware systems do not stand a chance against some of the attacks that malware authors develop, despite using machine learning based methods to thwart such attempts. Therefore, to evaluate the vulnerability of machine learning models, we propose two attack scenarios, the first based on reinforcement learning techniques and the second on a deep learning technique, that will perturb malicious samples to appear benign. This will in turn yield greater rate of misclassification. To further distinguish these adversarial examples, we propose one defensive scenario that will help make these classification models more robust against such attacks.We will use three publicly available datasets to benchmark our models.

articleTitle: A framework application for improving energy demand forecasting using digital twining
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Distributed Sensing and Intelligent Systems (ICDSIS 2021)
abstract: Energy management became an essential mindset toward sustainability. Analyzing energy demand rates facilitates the adoption of efficient energy management solutions. Moreover, forecasting future energy demand is needed to support decision makers in long-term strategic planning. Hence, energy consumption prediction using Artificial Intelligence (AI) becomes an important research field recently. However, forecasting models need to be trained on rich data to provide precise predictions. It sometimes can be difficult as irregularities could have very low frequency in the data. Therefore, this research paper proposes an innovative data construction framework to enhance the performance of AI-based energy demand forecasting solutions using Digital Twin Technology (DT). Nowadays, DT becomes an emerging technology in the industrial and energy sectors. In this research study, DT technology is utilized in constructing an extensive dataset that covers various scenarios to train AI models. This approach reduces the overestimation and underestimation of the prediction model and ensures the model generalization. In addition, the research study considers the impact of different external factors such as climatic factors, socioeconomic factors, etc. As a part of the framework, the performance of the trained models will be evaluated and validated using cross-validation and other evaluation metrics.

articleTitle: Optimal control and dynamic compensation of a mobile manipulator robot
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Distributed Sensing and Intelligent Systems (ICDSIS 2021)
abstract: This work proposes a controller for tracking trajectories and the ability to keep a desired internal configuration e.g., the handling and transport of objects in industrial field with redundant robots. For this kind of controller, the kinematic and dynamic model was developed considering, the Mobile Manipulator robot is conformed by a manipulator of 4 degrees of freedom (DOF) located on a differential mobile robot and the operating point is located at end-effector. Additionally; the kinematic model is used to developed the controller as optimization problem with restrictions, it was solved using the sequential quadratic programming maintaining the point of interest on the desired trajectory with desired internal configuration. Using the dynamic model this work mitigate velocity errors generated in the system. Moreover, the stability of the proposed controller demonstrated analytically and finally simulation tests are performed using the dynamics of the Akasha mobile manipulator to validate the proposed controller.

articleTitle: Mobile communication base station traffic prediction model for massive data—an optimized prediction method based on PSO-ELM
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Distributed Sensing and Intelligent Systems (ICDSIS 2021)
abstract: Through the analysis of a large amount of historical data, it is possible to make scientific predictions on the state of the future network system, which is conducive to reducing costs and increasing efficiency of network traffic management. We processed massive data in blocks to increase the running speed and ensure the effect of data cleaning. At the same time, we extracted and constructed three variables with extremely low correlation for the input of the problem one model to make the prediction model more realistic and more reasonable. We use the simple and fast-training Extreme Learning Machine (ELM) as the training model and adopt particle swarm optimization (PSO) to improve the prediction accuracy of the entire model. Through the test results, we can find that the prediction result of PSO-ELM (R<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>=0.86031) is better than the unoptimized extreme learning machine model.

articleTitle: Vehicle fault maintenance system based on AI intelligent application technology
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Distributed Sensing and Intelligent Systems (ICDSIS 2021)
abstract: In recent years, with the significant improvement of people's material living standards, cars began to enter more families, and the automobile industry ushered in a new spring of development. Although there has been great development since the first vehicle maintenance expert system came out, with the expansion of application scope and the improvement of expectation, many weak links have been exposed. In order to solve the problems of weak distribution ability, lack of knowledge, single solution and so on, this paper combines automobile rapid maintenance with new technology to construct intelligent fault diagnosis and system to further improve automobile maintenance efficiency. On this basis, the advantages of AI intelligence in automobile maintenance and fault diagnosis are analyzed, and the design and implementation of fault diagnosis and maintenance system are expounded. Through the analysis of 16 sample data, it is found that the rapid development of artificial intelligence technology has laid a solid foundation for the development of vehicle maintenance experts, and the application of computer and network technology provides a broad development space for the research of vehicle maintenance expert system.

articleTitle: Spread channel of dialectical materialism epistemology based on ZigBee wireless sensor network technology
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Distributed Sensing and Intelligent Systems (ICDSIS 2021)
abstract: With the vigorous development of the Internet of Things technology, various Internet of Things devices and technologies are widely used in various fields. As an important member of wireless sensor network technology, ZigBee network protocol is applied to the spread of dialectical materialism epistemology because of its specific advantages. The purpose of this article is to study the dialectical materialism epistemology propagation method based on ZigBee wireless sensor network technology. This article first analyzes the role of ZigBee wireless sensor network technology in the spread of dialectical materialism epistemology. Combining the characteristics of the current stage of the new media era and the actual situation of dialectical materialist epistemology dissemination, this paper investigates the use of ZigBee wireless sensor network technology in universities and the current situation of dialectical materialist epistemology dissemination. Develop an effective method of dissemination of dialectical materialist epistemology, so that dialectical materialist epistemology can be spread more efficiently. According to the survey data, the current dialectical materialist epistemology of H universities mainly relies on classroom teaching, accounting for 5939.54%, followed by the use of WeChat official accounts and Weibo accounts at 10.16% and 9.59%, reflecting the dialectical materialist epistemology of universities Lectures are still the main way of education, and students mainly listen to lectures.

articleTitle: Key technology of point cloud data texture reconstruction based on 3D acquisition
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Distributed Sensing and Intelligent Systems (ICDSIS 2021)
abstract: With the continuous development of science and technology, 3D acquisition and reconstruction technology based on point cloud data (PCD) texture can quickly recreate a very realistic 3D model from discrete points on the surface of the object. This technology has become the main technology in the field of 3D model reconstruction. The purpose of this paper is to study the key technology of texture reconstruction based on 3D collected PCD. This article first introduces three typical algorithms based on Delaunay triangulation in detail, and compares their advantages and disadvantages, and proposes a Delaunay triangle mesh reconstruction algorithm based on spatial adaptive circumscribed sphere. This paper proposes a new mesh smoothing algorithm that maintains the characteristics of the model in order to solve the problem of the convex edges and corners of the reconstructed mesh model. By combining the advantages of the Laplace operator and the average curvature method, the regularity of the triangle surface is improved, and the area of the second-order neighborhood triangle is used as the weight to improve the bilateral filter. Experiments on the 3D meshing of the Bunny monkey point cloud show that the simplification rate of the algorithm proposed in this study is 80.78%, and the simplification rate of the point cloud feature point detection method based on point signature is 48.51%. It shows that the feature point extraction of this algorithm is more accurate, and the simplification efficiency is relatively high.

articleTitle: Construction method of fire emergency rescue communication network based on mixed organization and self-organization
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Distributed Sensing and Intelligent Systems (ICDSIS 2021)
abstract: Tother article first discusses the severe situation of the emergency communication requirements of the fire rescue team at the emergency rescue site, and then analyses the current situation and existing problems of the current fire emergency rescue communication network. In response to the problem, a fire emergency communication network based on a mixture of other organizations and self-organizations is proposed, and the network structure, construction method, networking process and network status change rules are elaborated in detail. Finally, the fire emergency communication network construction method constructed in tother paper is compared with the traditional emergency communication network construction method.

articleTitle: Intelligent system for part-of-speech tagging using convolutional neural network on arabic language
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Distributed Sensing and Intelligent Systems (ICDSIS 2021)
abstract: Part of speech tagging is the process of assigning the grammar and the morphology of words such as (noun, verb, adjective, article, and preposition... etc.). The principal challenges for this task are: first, the ambiguity (when a word can take several possible tags), and secondly the problem of rare words (in particular, words that did not appear in the training examples). In the past few years, the Neural Part of Speech Tagging has achieved competitive results with the use of deep learning, and this paper aims, thus, to provide an addition to the literature by the usage of Character-Level Convolution networks on Arabic language. We have experimentally implemented our model on the Boundary-Annotated Quran (BAQ) dataset, and we used the augmentation techniques to enhance the accuracy of the 1D convolutional neural network by adding handcrafted features. The results show 1D convolutional neural networks with a handcrafted feature outperformed, where we achieved a training accuracy of 97.04 % where the model without handcrafted features achieved 96.95 %.

articleTitle: Communication with HD7279A based on McBSP serial port
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Distributed Sensing and Intelligent Systems (ICDSIS 2021)
abstract: The McBSP serial port of TI's series DSP devices has powerful functions and is the main way to communicate with external devices. By configuring McBSP serial port, DSP can communicate with various devices. This paper studies the method of configuring McBSP serial port as general I / O, and the connection method between HD7279A and CMU. This paper studies the interface connection method between TMS320VC5416 and HD7279A, connecting the pins CLKR2, CLKX2, FSX2 and INT3 of McBSP serial port 2 with the pins CS, CLK, DATA and KEY of HD7279A respectively. In this paper, the parameter setting and communication are realized by C language programming. Firstly, the related registers are defined by C language. Secondly, CLKR2, CLKX2, and FSX2 are set as general I / O ports. When TMS320VC5416 sends data to HD7279A, CLKX2 sends data as the CLK signal of HD7279A, and FSX2 sends corresponding data bit by bit to the DATA pin of HD7279A. In order to match the working speed of both, each bit needs 16μs delay. When TMS320VC5416 receives data, INT3 interrupt is used. The method studied in this paper has been successfully applied in a DSP I / O system composed of TMS320VC5416, HD7279A, 16 digital keys and 8 digital tubes.

articleTitle: A Comparative study for sentiment analysis of raw and translated text
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Distributed Sensing and Intelligent Systems (ICDSIS 2021)
abstract: Sentiment analysis is a type of opinion mining study analyzing people's thoughts, feelings, and assessments evaluations of society things such as products, services, and institutions individuals, organizations, events and etc. This paper focuses on an effective machine learning model, Recurrent Neural Network (RNN), for sentiment analysis of both Bengali and English text. For sentiment analysis of Bengali text, we construct a novel dataset accumulated from different open source sites and social media. The dataset comprises over 17,000 texts, which are labelled as neutral, positive, and negative. Our study provides a rigorous comparative analysis on the performance of RNN in terms of sentiment analysis of both raw text and corresponding translated text (for both English and Bengali language). In summary, we achieve 82.9% and 84.5% accuracies for sentiment analysis of Bengali and English text respectively using RNN.

articleTitle: Temporal residual self-attention based radar target trajectory prediction
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Distributed Sensing and Intelligent Systems (ICDSIS 2021)
abstract: With the increasing popularity of unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) and the continuous development of the commercial airline industry, anomalous and illegal flights occur frequently, which imposes a great threat on the aviation. Accurate prediction of UAV trajectories is a great demand to ensure the safety of airspace. Existing popular ground target trajectory prediction methods cannot be directly applied to the trajectory prediction of UAVs, since the trajectories of flying targets are significantly different from the trajectories of ground targets. The flight trajectory consists of a time series of radar data, and the attention mechanism can improve the processing performance of the time-series data. However, the traditional attention mechanism only considers the attention of each data point. In this paper, we propose a self-attention mechanism based on temporal residuals, which not only considers attention of track points, but also implements attention distribution of track data on the time domain to better represent the global dependence of the current prediction moment on all track points. On the basis of the time residual self-attention mechanism, we propose a track prediction model based on time Residual Self-Attention (TRSA). We conduct experiments on the flight data provided by global flight data services website VariFlight. Experimental results show that model TRSA can effectively improve the target trajectory performance in terms of root mean squared error (RMSE) and mean absolute error (MAE).

articleTitle: Telemedicine and smart systems techniques for COVID-19: a systematic review
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Distributed Sensing and Intelligent Systems (ICDSIS 2021)
abstract: Coronavirus 2019 (COVID-19) is a global pandemic, which has placed a significant challenge on the earth for health, climate, and human life. A critical study of the most used protocols to help physicians establish a reliable diagnosis, prevention, and treatment protocols are among the top targets for controlling and tracking COVID-19. Individuals disregard the necessary safeguards and engage in various misbehavior, such as socializing with others or leaving during holidays. This novel coronavirus has infected the earth with a disabled person of trade, hygiene, and other aspects of life. Treatment protocols differ by country, and there is currently no approved treatment. Therefore, the discovery of drugs to treat COVID-19 is critical. This paper presents a comprehensive analysis of COVID-19 with a wide range of viewpoints, such as related factors to COVID-19 as clinical characteristics, comorbidities (obesity, cardiovascular diseases), maternal and fetal, children, mental health, smoking, supply chain disciplines, vaccines, and therapeutics. Also, a comparison between the first wave of pandemic and the second wave is presented. Besides, the role of technologies in fighting against COVID-19 and the function of artificial intelligence, deep learning, and medical images for the analysis of pandemics are discussed in this paper. Finally, our survey results and comparison between it and other surveys are also illustrated at the end of the paper.

articleTitle: Adaptive trajectory tracking sliding mode control for agricultural tracked robot considering parameter uncertainty
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Distributed Sensing and Intelligent Systems (ICDSIS 2021)
abstract: The trajectory tracking process of the robot is easily affected by the smoothness of the ground, the external uncertainty interference, the integrity of feedback information and other factors, which lead to the degradation of the trajectory tracking performance of the mobile robot. In order to improve the performance of tracking control of agricultural tracked robot, this paper takes tracked robot as the research object, and presents an adaptive sliding mode control. The main research contents are as follows: Based on the consideration of the kinematics model of the tracked robot and the dynamic characteristics of the motor drive model, an adaptive integral sliding mode switching function with variable tilt parameters is constructed. Based on the established sliding mode function, an adaptive sliding mode control composed of equivalent control and switching control was designed. The pose error of the robot and the time-varying uncertain parameters of the drive motor identified online were fed back into the controller, and the expected angular velocity of the left and right wheel drive motor was calculated to control the running of the tracked robot. Simulation results verified the effectiveness of the proposed method, and field test results showed that when the robot was running at the speeds of 1 m/s, 3 m/s, and 4 m/s, the distance error in the movement direction, the lateral distance error, and the heading angle error were -0.04m-0.04m, -0.09m-0.07m and -0.03-0.05rad. Therefore, the robot adaptive sliding mode control had good control accuracy and could meet the requirements of actual field operations. 1

articleTitle: Stable V2V routing protocol based on deep reinforcement learning in VANETs
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Distributed Sensing and Intelligent Systems (ICDSIS 2021)
abstract: The V2V quick communication protocol in VANETs is restricted by the propagation direction and transmission stability. Therefore, the V2V communication formed by vehicles into a self-organizing network faces the challenges of route finding and link broken. In this paper,in order to reduce the sensitivity of the network to vehicles with high mobility, we propose a routing protocol based on geographic location and deep reinforcement learning.Firstly,the Protocol based on Deep Q-learning Network (DQN-P) divides the map into several grids with the same size which contain different paths that connect adjacent grids. Secondly,a message agent chooses one of several paths(actions) that connect adjacent regions.Then actions with high probability of connectivity that calculate by historical traffic density data for certain period of time will be given higher feedback rewards. After neural network trained with DQN algorithm, the agent can find the routing direction with high-connectivity probability grid sequence and path combination to the fixed destination at different time intervals. Finally,the vehicle forwards the message in the routing direction according to the forwarding strategy and Improved DQN-P(DQN-I) further improves the DQN-P performance by predicting the density data of the vehicle's future travel trajectory.Simulation results show that DQN-P and DQN-I protocol can find the grid sequence and path combination efficiently,and improve the end-to-end data delivery rate.

articleTitle: Wireless network security technology and application in colleges and universities
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Distributed Sensing and Intelligent Systems (ICDSIS 2021)
abstract: The rapid development of computer technology has penetrated into all areas of people's work and life. At the same time, with the rapid development of wireless network technology, colleges and universities have become the biggest beneficiaries of the later development of wireless network technology. At the same time, the problem of wireless network security technology and application in colleges and universities is an unavoidable problem in the current Internet era, and the development of network security technology is also changing with each passing day. The purpose of this article is to study wireless network security technology and applications in colleges and universities. This research summarizes and analyzes the current status of wireless network security and the development trends and key technologies in this field. Through case investigation and case analysis, the current wireless network security characteristics and network security technology applications in universities are investigated and analyzed, and the university is summarized Wireless network security features and applications. Combining the current mainstream wireless network security protection technology and security protection strategy, research and design a multi-level, multi-measure university wireless network security protection program to ensure the network security of colleges and universities. Taking a university as an example, the research and application of the wireless network security event detection method and application scheme using data fusion technology designed and proposed in this study for the wireless network security technology of universities and colleges have been verified through actual security technology application and effect testing the effectiveness and applicability of the proposed algorithm and scheme. The survey results show that for a sensor network with 1250 nodes, the efficiency of the algorithm proposed in this study is 2.1%, while the efficiency of this protocol of the MCTA algorithm is 0.9%, and that of the Gur Game algorithm is 0.27%. Compared with the other two methods, the algorithm and scheme proposed in the article are more suiTable for intensive dynamic wireless sensor network security technology applications.

articleTitle: Region-level arabic dialect identification using deep learning models
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Distributed Sensing and Intelligent Systems (ICDSIS 2021)
abstract: The automatic classification of the Arabic language dialects is the preliminary step towards establishing many dialectal-sensitive Arabic natural language processing tasks. Arabic dialect identification entails predicting the dialects associated with specific textual inputs and classifying them under their respected labels. In this paper, we propose a novel approach by merging several distinct datasets to obtain a large, diverse, and bias-free dialectal corpus. Our dataset is a collection of parallel sentences translated into multiple dialects (MADAR), as well as tweets gathered from Twitter users (NADI-2020, NADI-2021, QADI, & ARAP-Tweet 2.0). The collected dataset is classified into seven labels: Gulf, Levant, Iraq, Maghreb, Nile Basin, Yemen, and Modern Standard Arabic. The merged dataset was cleansed to produce Arabic sentences free of punctuation, non-Arabic characters, numbers, repeating characters, empty lines, and elongation characters. We obtained a high dialectal classification accuracy using a new Word2vec embedding model on the merged dialectal dataset. Seven deep learning systems were trained on a balanced subset of the dataset. These models are Convolutional Neural Network (CNN), Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM), Gated Recurrent Unit (GRU), Bidirectional-LSTM (BILSTM), Bidirectional-GRU (BIGRU), Convolutional-LSTM (CLSTM), and Convolutional-GRU (CGRU). Single-label classification tests ran on these trained models acquired a minimum accuracy of 77.90% (CNN) and a maximum accuracy of 81.52% (BILSTM). We further evaluated the accuracy of tests ran for short and long sentences with 87.52% attained accuracy for classifying short sentences with CGRU and 94.06% for long sentences using BIGRU, both of which are indications of proposed approach efficacy to move forward.

articleTitle: An efficient binary harris hawks optimization based on quantum SVM for cancer classification tasks
publicationTitle: The 2nd International Conference on Distributed Sensing and Intelligent Systems (ICDSIS 2021)
abstract: Cancer classification based on gene expression increases early diagnosis and recovery, but high-dimensional genes with a small number of samples are a major challenge. This work introduces a new hybrid quantum-kernel support vector machine (QKSVM) combined with a Binary Harris hawk optimization (BHHO)-based gene selection for cancer classification on a quantum simulator. This study aims to improve the microarray cancer prediction performance with the quantum kernel estimation based on the informative genes by BHHO. The feature selection is a critical step in large-dimensional features, and BHHO is used to select important features. The BHHO mimics the behavior of the cooperative action of Harris hawks in nature. The principal component analysis (PCA) is applied to reduce the selected genes to match the qubit numbers. After which, the quantum computer is used to estimate the kernel with the training data of the reduced genes and generate the quantum kernel matrix. Moreover, the classical computer is used to draw the support vectors based on the quantum kernel matrix. Also, the prediction stage is performed with the classical device. Finally, the proposed approach is applied to colon and breast microarray datasets and evaluated with all genes and the selected genes by BHHO. The proposed approach (QKSVM{PCA{BHHO) is found to enhance the overall performance with two datasets. Also, the proposed approach is evaluated with different quantum feature maps (kernels) and classical kernel (RBF).
